claim: Quick Switcher opens with Ctrl/Cmd+O; type to search, Enter to open, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter for new tab, Shift+Enter to create with exact name
quote: Open Quick switcher. Ctrl+O (Cmd+O on macOS)... Press Enter to open the selected note... Open in New Tab: Use Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) to open the selected note in a separate tab.

claim: Obsidian ships ~30 first-party 'core' plugins (Backlinks, Bases, Bookmarks, Canvas, Command palette, Daily notes, File explorer, Graph view, Outline, Page preview, Properties view, Quick switcher, Search, Slash commands, Templates, Workspaces, etc.); some are disabled by default
quote: Core plugins... Audio recorder, Backlinks, Bases, Bookmarks, Canvas, Command palette, Daily notes, File explorer, File recovery, Footnotes view, Format converter, Graph view, Note composer, Outgoing links, Outline, Page preview, Properties view, Publish, Quick switcher...

claim: The four highest-leverage default hotkeys for keyboard-only workflows are Ctrl+P (command palette), Ctrl+O (quick switcher), Ctrl+Shift+F (global search), Ctrl+Shift+T (reopen last tab)
quote: Command palette: Ctrl+P... described as 'the ultimate Obsidian shortcut'... Quick Switcher: Ctrl+O... Global Search: Ctrl+Shift+F... Reopen Last Tab: Ctrl+Shift+T - reopens last tab and cycles through earlier tabs if you keep pressing

claim: Default Obsidian shortcuts include Ctrl+P palette, Ctrl+O switcher, Ctrl+E toggle edit/preview, Ctrl+K insert link, Ctrl+Alt+Left/Right navigate back/forward, Ctrl+G graph view, Ctrl+, settings, Ctrl+W close pane, Ctrl+Shift+F global search
quote: Quick Switcher: Ctrl+O ... Command Palette: Ctrl+P ... Navigate Back: Ctrl+Alt+Left ... Navigate Forward: Ctrl+Alt+Right ... Toggle Edit/Preview Mode: Ctrl+E ... Insert Link: Ctrl+K ... Close Active Pane: Ctrl+W ... Search All Files: Ctrl+Shift+F

claim: A tier-listing of Obsidian's 30 core plugins ranks Bases, Canvas, Command palette, Daily notes and Templates as S/A-tier; Audio recorder, Random note and Slides as F-tier
quote: S Tier - Bases: a game-changer for Obsidian users; Canvas. A Tier - Command Palette: Primary navigation tool; Daily Notes; Templates... F Tier - Audio Recorder, Random Note, Slides—author warns these lack practical utility

claim: 2026 must-have community plugins curated by Sébastien Dubois include Dataview, Templater, Excalidraw, Kanban, Periodic Notes, Quick Switcher++, QuickAdd, Omnisearch, Local Backup and TaskNotes
quote: Dataview - Query, filter, and display vault data with a query language ... Excalidraw - Full-featured drawing and diagramming tool ... Kanban - Create Kanban boards in Obsidian ... Periodic Notes... Quick Switcher Plus Plus - Enhanced file navigation by headings and symbols ... Templater

claim: Obsibrain's 2026 essentials lead with Calendar, Periodic Notes, Recent Files, Dataview, Tasks, Templater, QuickAdd and Obsidian Git for the daily-driver vault
quote: Calendar - date-based navigation through a sidebar month view ... Periodic Notes - Extends daily notes to weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly ... Dataview - database engine ... Tasks - Provides robust task management ... Templater ... QuickAdd ... Obsidian Git

claim: Desktop Commander's 2026 'must-have' tier surfaces Settings Search and Commander as the two plugins that most dramatically reduce friction in stock Obsidian
quote: Must-Have Plugins: Settings Search - Adds searchable settings panel for quick plugin configuration without scrolling through tabs. Commander - Places frequently-used commands directly in the UI (title bar, ribbon, context menus) instead of relying on the command palette.

claim: Quick Switcher++ adds modes for Headings (#), Symbols (@), Editor, Workspace, Commands and Related-items navigation, shareable as separate hotkeys
quote: Quick Switcher++ is an Obsidian plugin that enhances the built-in Quick Switcher... registers multiple global commands accessible via hotkeys, including options to launch in Standard Mode, Editor Mode, Headings Mode, Symbols Mode, Workspaces Mode, and Commands Mode

claim: The Vimrc Support plugin loads .obsidian.vimrc on startup, supports nmap/imap/vmap and exposes the obcommand directive so Vim mappings can fire Obsidian commands
quote: This plugin supports loading a vimrc file ... obcommand - executes Obsidian application commands ... Standard Vim mapping commands: nmap, imap, vmap (normal, insert, visual mode mappings); noremap, iunmap, nunmap, vunmap; Leader key support via let mapleader

claim: The Obsidian Hub's Vim-user guide warns that the underlying CodeMirror Vim emulation is incomplete — most commands work, some don't — and recommends pairing native Vim mode with the Vimrc Support plugin
quote: Be aware that Obsidian relies on CodeMirror's vim emulation, which does not include all vim commands, but most of them. The hub strongly recommends using the vimrc Support Plugin to leverage an obsidian-specific .vimrc file

claim: Dataview is the de-facto Obsidian query engine for treating notes as a database with table/list/task queries
quote: Dataview - Query, filter, and display vault data with a query language

claim: Templater extends Obsidian's built-in Templates plugin with JavaScript execution, dynamic variables and system commands inside templates
quote: Templater is a template language that lets you insert variables and functions results into your notes. It will also let you execute JavaScript code

claim: Tasks adds query-able, recurring-aware checkboxes to Markdown across the vault with due/start/scheduled dates and a filtering DSL
quote: Task management for the Obsidian knowledge base. Track tasks across your entire vault. Query them and mark them as done wherever you want.

claim: Excalidraw integrates a full sketching/whiteboarding canvas as a first-class note type
quote: A plugin to edit and view Excalidraw drawings in Obsidian

claim: Calendar adds a sidebar month view that creates/opens the Daily Note for the clicked date, wiring Daily Notes + Periodic Notes into the side panel
quote: Simple calendar widget for Obsidian

claim: Periodic Notes extends Daily Notes with weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly note types — each with its own template and folder
quote: Create/manage your daily, weekly, and monthly notes

claim: QuickAdd makes it possible to bind one keystroke to a templated capture or macro, lowering friction for inbox-style note creation
quote: Quickly add new pages or content to your vault

claim: Omnisearch provides a faster full-text and fuzzy search across notes (and PDFs on desktop) than the built-in search
quote: A search engine that 'just works' for Obsidian. Includes OCR and PDF indexing.

claim: Kanban turns a Markdown file into a draggable board with checkbox-backed cards
quote: Create markdown-backed Kanban boards in Obsidian

claim: Style Settings exposes CSS variables exported by themes/snippets as a normal Obsidian settings panel — toggles, dropdowns, colors and numbers
quote: A dynamic user interface for adjusting theme, plugin, and snippet CSS variables within Obsidian

claim: Commander lets you pin commands and plugin actions to ribbon, title bar, file menu and right-click menus per device
quote: Add Commands to every part of Obsidian's user interface

claim: Breadcrumbs adds typed parent/sibling/child links and renders matrix and trail views you can navigate by keyboard
quote: Add typed-links to your Obsidian notes. View/traverse them in various ways.

claim: Obsidian Git provides scheduled auto-commit-and-push, mobile-aware backup and a Source Control view inside Obsidian — the standard free-tier alternative to Obsidian Sync for versioning
quote: Integrate Git version control with automatic commit-and-sync and other advanced features in Obsidian.md

claim: Long-running community thread on hotkey customization converges on two themes: prioritise left-hand-only chords for navigation, and treat the default bindings as a starting point rather than a final answer
quote: hotkeys are a personal thing... prioritize left-hand keyboard combinations to minimize mouse/right-hand movement... pairing navigation commands like Navigate back and forward with accessible key combos such as Cmd + Opt + Z and Cmd + Opt + X

claim: Pane Relief gives every pane its own back/forward history (browser-style) and adds hotkeys to focus or move between adjacent panes — the missing tab/pane navigation for keyboard users
quote: per-pane history, pane movement/navigation hotkeys, and more

claim: Settings Search adds a global search field to Obsidian's Settings window so plugin options are reachable by name instead of by scrolling
quote: Adds a search bar to Obsidian.md's settings

claim: Obsidian Mate's 2026 short-list highlights Remotely Save (free cross-device sync via personal cloud) and Self-hosted LiveSync (encrypted real-time sync) as the two leading no-fee alternatives to paid Obsidian Sync
quote: Remotely Save - Enables sync your Obsidian vault across all your devices without paid subscriptions using personal cloud storage. Self-hosted LiveSync - Provides real-time, conflict-free sync with encryption
